newsitem.title: CANADA: Manitoba harvests 75 pct of crops, little frost.
newsitem.headline: Manitoba harvests 75 pct of crops, little frost.

text.p: Manitoba's harvest advanced rapidly on good weather but was delayed by one inch of rain on the weekend, Manitoba Agriculture's report for the week ended September 23 said.
Southwest Manitoba - Eighty percent of crops were combined with yields at or above average. Light frost occured with no reports of damage.

Northwest Manitoba - Sixty percent of crops were combined with yields above average. Wheat yielded 35 bushels an acre, half graded No1 Canada Western Red Spring with good protein. Canola yield was 25 to 30 bu/ac.
Central Manitoba - Seventy-five percent of cereals were combined and 50 percent of oilseeds were combined. Light frost was reported.
Eastern Manitoba - Cereals were 75 to 90 percent combined, 50 percent of canola was harvested.
Interlake region - Eighty percent of cereals, 90 percent of canola and 50 percent of flax were combined. Yields were above average.
